## What it is

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> See the history of football through a unique collection of match-used items, 4D cinema, virtual reality, and more. Explore the seven floors of the museum at your own pace.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €28.75. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 37 ratings and 21 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
